svg.title: AD-2 Find eligible candidates for shift S (date d, start s, end e) — BR-01

g.text: AD-2 Find eligible candidates for shift S (date d, start s, end e) — BR-01
candidates := all Worker of the workplace
W has a shift on date d
W has an Availability slot on weekday(d)
with slotStart <= s and slotEnd >= e?
